title: MIRATask
description: Defines the canonical data model and lifecycle contract for a MIRA task executed between Phone 1, the Flask Backend, and the Windows Laptop MCP Server.

task_id.description: Unique UUIDv4 identifier for the task.

user_id.description: Unique UUIDv4 identifying the human user owning the task, distinct from device identity.

device_id.description: UUIDv4 identifier of the initiating Phone 1 client device.

title.description: Human-readable interpretation title generated by MIRA for user confirmation.

description.description: Expanded summary of the interpreted task goals and intended execution steps.

raw_prompt.description: Original raw natural language or voice transcription input received from Phone 1.

status.description: Current lifecycle status of the task.

risk_level.description: Assessed operational risk level determined during the validation stage.

consequential.description: Flag indicating if the task alters state, mutates workstation files, executes scripts, or requires user sign-off.

approval_id.description: Reference UUID of the associated approval record if the task is consequential.

tool_calls.description: Log of tool invocations dispatched to the Windows Laptop MCP Server.

call_id.description: Unique identifier for this tool execution call.

tool_name.description: Registered FastMCP tool identifier (e.g., generate_svg_poster, execute_script).

arguments.description: Sanitized JSON parameters passed to the MCP server tool.

result.description: Structured return value received from the MCP tool.

error.description: Error diagnostic message if the tool execution failed.

artifacts.description: List of physical artifact metadata generated by the task on the Windows workstation.

verification_result.description: Evaluation result proving output validity prior to marking task completed.

completed_at.description: ISO 8601 completion timestamp, recorded only after verification succeeds.

metadata.description: Arbitrary client-provided or system context tags.
